_comment: Curated per-system facts, merged into generation. Keyed by (sector, hex); 'world' is checked against TravellerMap so a mistyped hex fails loudly. Validate with: cargo run --bin validate-overrides --features backend

overrides.note: Drinaxian Companion ch.5. Star (F4 V), 2 belts, 4 gas giants and 10 rocky worlds already match TravellerMap's stellar/PBG/W data, so only the named body is recorded. Traefar is 'the next world out from Torpol', said relatively because that is what the book says — the absolute orbit is a derived fact that would go stale if generation shifted.

Drinaxian Companion ch.7. Star (F9 V) and 2 gas giants match TravellerMap. Bulhai is 'the system's outer gas giant'; Bulhai Freeport sits on one of its moons, pop ~20,000 (code 4). Port class F (the spaceport equivalent of C): it builds small craft and does minor refits - electronics and weaponry - but the book has it 'may come to rival the main starport at Blue', so it sits below Blue's B today.

Drinaxian Companion ch.11: 'Palindrome's primary is a K7 V, an orange main sequence star.' TravellerMap has K9 V. The companion (M1 V, distant, no planetary bodies of its own) and the 2 gas giants / 3 rocky worlds both match, so only the primary's class is corrected.
